scaffolding: Real sqlite3 (standard library). The database is the file frSSH.db in the current folder, same name as in the snippet; the tests switch the current folder to a temporary one (monkeypatch.chdir).

_prepare_database(registered): creates the table servers (ip, port, username, password, keyid) if it does not exist and stores the servers already registered. Columns without a declared type, because the original schema (dbinitalization.py) is not in the dataset; so SQLite stores the values as received.
_rows(): reads the whole table in insertion order (rowid).
run(registered, server): prepares the database, unpacks server (tuple of 5) in the call to the function of the snippet and returns the rows of the table.
Checked: Pysmell only flags the function of the snippet (PAR=5); nothing in the scaffolding.
pinned_behavior: typical: one server registered, stores a new one (keyid None); the table ends up with both, in order, and prints 'Server added.'.
edge: stores again a server already registered; it becomes a second identical row (the table has no uniqueness constraint) and prints the message.
invalid: a port given as a list raises sqlite3.ProgrammingError; nothing printed and the table keeps only the registered server.
not_pinned_on_purpose: Connection left open when the INSERT fails: accidental side effect, not observable by the caller.
